text: In the internal language of a topos, existential quantification ∃x.φ(x) corresponds to:
choices: the image of the display map for φ
the pullback of φ along the diagonal
explanation: ∃x.φ corresponds to the image of the projection from {(x,p) | p:φ(x)} to the base. In set-theoretic terms, ∃x.φ is the direct image of the display map.
